learning_outcomes.text: Based on the natural science and engineering fundamentals, the relationship between structure and properties (e.g., strength, toughness, corrosion resistance, etc.), application, and processing (e.g., weldability, formability, etc.) of engineering materials is taught.
Students can describe the relationship between material structure and material properties.
They are able to classify the different material groups, especially with regard to their mechanical properties and processability.
They know the application limits of engineering materials and can assess and justify their use.
They are able to consider the fundamental aspects of sustainability and derive recommendations for design.

syllabus_topics: Atomic structure and chemical bonds in technical materials
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon passing the module exam. The grade's weight for the final grade is based on the credit points.
bibliography: All documents (script, exercise sheets, etc.) are provided digitally via the e-learning platform. Secondary literature is available as an e-book:
